beats.say: Wash your hands, not your antenna!
Use soap, and scrub for twenty seconds.
Yes! Rub, rub, rub, all over your hands.
Did you wash your hands today?

sources.fact: Wet hands, apply soap, lather, scrub for at least 20 seconds, rinse under clean running water, dry with a clean towel or air dryer

math.note: scrub for at least 20 seconds (CDC, About Handwashing)

post.instagram_caption:
Wibbo is washing his hands... sort of! He scrubbed his antenna instead.

The right way: soap, scrub all over for 20 seconds, then rinse and dry. Humming Happy Birthday twice takes about that long!

Silly Wibbo. Smart kids.

Did YOU wash your hands today?
